passages.text: Come, let us return to the LORD. For He has torn us to pieces, but He will heal us; He has wounded us, but He will bind up our wounds.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He has power to judge and to heal.
Let us return to the LORD.
He has torn us to pieces.
He will heal us.
He has wounded us.
He will bind up our wounds.
passages.original: לְכוּ֙ וְנָשׁ֣וּבָה אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י ה֥וּא טָרָ֖ף וְיִרְפָּאֵ֑נוּ יַ֖ךְ וְיַחְבְּשֵֽׁנוּ׃

passages.text: After two days He will revive us; on the third day He will raise us up, that we may live in His presence.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God has power to restore life.
After two days, God will revive us.
On the third day, God will raise us up.
We will live before God.
We will be in His presence.
passages.original: יְחַיֵּ֖נוּ מִיֹּמָ֑יִם בַּיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יְקִמֵ֖נוּ וְנִחְיֶ֥ה לְפָנָֽיו׃

passages.text: So let us know— let us press on to know the LORD. As surely as the sun rises, He will appear; He will come to us like the rain, like the spring showers that water the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He is faithful.
Let us seek to know the LORD.
Let us keep trying to know Him more.
The LORD will surely come to us.
He will come as certainly as the sun rises each day.
He will come to us like rain falls on the earth.
He will come like spring showers that water the ground.
passages.original: וְנֵדְעָ֣ה נִרְדְּפָ֗ה לָדַ֙עַת֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה כְּשַׁ֖חַר נָכ֣וֹן מֽוֹצָא֑וֹ וְיָב֤וֹא כַגֶּ֙שֶׁם֙ לָ֔נוּ כְּמַלְק֖וֹשׁ י֥וֹרֶה אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: What shall I do with you, O Ephraim ? What shall I do with you, O Judah? For your loyalty is like a morning mist, like the early dew that vanishes.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Ephraim and Judah.
God asks, “What shall I do with you, Ephraim?”
God asks, “What shall I do with you, Judah?”
Your loyalty disappears quickly.
Your loyalty is like a morning cloud.
Your loyalty is like the early dew that goes away.
passages.original: מָ֤ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ לְּךָ֙ אֶפְרַ֔יִם מָ֥ה אֶעֱשֶׂה־ לְּךָ֖ יְהוּדָ֑ה וְחַסְדְּכֶם֙ כַּֽעֲנַן־ בֹּ֔קֶר וְכַטַּ֖ל מַשְׁכִּ֥ים הֹלֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: Therefore I have hewn them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of My mouth, and My judgments go forth like lightning.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God uses prophets to deliver His message.
God shapes and corrects His people through the prophets.
God uses His words to judge and discipline.
God’s judgments are powerful and clear.
God’s judgments go out quickly, like lightning.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֗ן חָצַ֙בְתִּי֙ בַּנְּבִיאִ֔ים הֲרַגְתִּ֖ים בְּאִמְרֵי־ פִ֑י וּמִשְׁפָּטֶ֖יךָ א֥וֹר יֵצֵֽא׃

passages.text: For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God says what He wants.
God wants mercy.
God does not want sacrifice.
God wants people to know Him.
God does not want burnt offerings.
passages.original: כִּ֛י חֶ֥סֶד חָפַ֖צְתִּי וְלֹא־ זָ֑בַח וְדַ֥עַת אֱלֹהִ֖ים מֵעֹלֽוֹת׃

passages.text: But they, like Adam, have transgressed the covenant; there they were unfaithful to Me.
passages.sermon:
The people broke My covenant.
They acted like Adam.
Adam also broke My command.
There, the people were unfaithful to Me.
They betrayed Me.
passages.original: וְהֵ֕מָּה כְּאָדָ֖ם עָבְר֣וּ בְרִ֑ית שָׁ֖ם בָּ֥גְדוּ בִֽי׃

passages.text: Gilead is a city of evildoers, tracked with footprints of blood.
passages.sermon:
Gilead is a city.
The people in Gilead do evil.
Blood stains mark the city.
You can see the tracks of blood everywhere in Gilead.
Evil actions fill this city.
passages.original: גִּלְעָ֕ד קִרְיַ֖ת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן עֲקֻבָּ֖ה מִדָּֽם׃

passages.text: Like raiders who lie in ambush, so does a band of priests; they murder on the way to Shechem; surely they have committed atrocities.
passages.sermon:
A group of priests acts like raiders who wait in ambush.
These priests attack people on the road to Shechem.
They murder travelers there.
They have done evil things.
passages.original: וּכְחַכֵּ֨י אִ֜ישׁ גְּדוּדִ֗ים חֶ֚בֶר כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים דֶּ֖רֶךְ יְרַצְּחוּ־ שֶׁ֑כְמָה כִּ֥י זִמָּ֖ה עָשֽׂוּ׃

passages.text: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing: Ephraim practices prostitution there, and Israel is defiled.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about the people of Israel.
God sees everything that happens in Israel.
God sees a horrible thing in Israel.
Ephraim commits prostitution in Israel.
Because of this, Israel becomes defiled.
passages.original: בְּבֵית֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רָאִ֖יתִי שַׁעֲרִירִיָּה שָׁ֚ם זְנ֣וּת לְאֶפְרַ֔יִם נִטְמָ֖א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Also for you, O Judah, a harvest is appointed, when I restore My people from captivity.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Judah.
God says a harvest is coming for Judah.
God will appoint this harvest.
God will restore His people from captivity.
God will bring His people back.
This will happen at the time of restoration.
passages.original: גַּם־ יְהוּדָ֕ה שָׁ֥ת קָצִ֖יר לָ֑ךְ בְּשׁוּבִ֖י שְׁב֥וּת עַמִּֽי׃פ
